subject: Planning Playbook: targets, scenario bands & QBR readiness
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood-inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Nina Patel <nina@kpiadvisors.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Planning Playbook: targets, scenario bands & QBR readiness

Team —

Kicking off our annual planning playbook thread. Goal: land target bands, define three scenario ladders (Base / Conservative / Upside), and validate what we need for the June QBR readiness review. I attached a simple template to capture assumptions by OKR and by product area. Quick asks up front: 

- Owners: please assign a single numeric owner per OKR (who submits the final target band).
- Inputs due: initial band + 2-sentence rationale by EOD Friday (2026-05-22).
- Finance needs roll-up numbers for their model by Wed 05/27.

Proposed timeline: 
- 05/20: Playbook + templates shared (this email).
- 05/22: Teams submit target bands & scenario triggers.
- 05/25: Cross-functional review (capacity, go-to-market, engineering).
- 05/27: Finance roll-up completed.
- 06/03: QBR readiness dry-run.

Important context: we want scenario triggers that are operational (e.g., % traffic growth, latency/regression thresholds, unit cost thresholds) so rollbacks and canary budgets are meaningful. I put a starter section in the sheet for "operational triggers" and included a short QBR checklist.

Attachments: Planning_Playbook_Template.xlsx (sheet: targets_by_okr), QBR-Prep-Checklist.pdf

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3C_planning-playbook

If there are major open items (procurement pricing changes, capacity constraints, or sales pipeline assumptions for named accounts like ACME), flag them inline so we can escalate.

Ben
Ben Carter
Sr. Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood-inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>, Nina Patel <nina@kpiadvisors.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Planning Playbook: targets, scenario bands & QBR readiness

Thanks Ben — this looks solid. A few notes from GTM: 

- I'll own the sales bookings band and provide a region split (NA / EU / APAC) by Friday.
- For ACME (Sarah Lee) I recommend using a conservative close timing in Base and mid-Q3 in Upside; I'll include a line item in the sheet.
- Can we add a column for "probability" (sales-sourced) so Finance can weight?

Also proposing a 30-minute cross-functional sync on Mon 05/25 at 10:00 AM PT to walk through contentious cases. If that works I'll send a calendar invite.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Global Sales Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood-inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Planning Playbook: targets, scenario bands & QBR readiness

Appreciate the structure. A couple of operational constraints to call out: 

- Dedicated capacity: current pool utilization is already at 78% for our committed customers; Upside scenarios that assume >25% q/q traffic growth will require procurement or temporary burst capacity.
- Latency SLOs: if Base assumes lower sampling rate while Upside assumes same latency, we need to factor in model selection / quantization cost.

Action: engineering will provide a capacity delta table by 05/22 with estimated $/token impact for each scenario. Laura — can you confirm whether we should treat Dedicated burst as "capital" or "opex" for FY27 modelling?

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Infrastructure & Product Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood-inference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 09:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Planning Playbook: targets, scenario bands & QBR readiness

Quick note from product: 

- We'll draft a "canary scenario" for new model rollouts that includes an explicit performance budget (tokens/sec and latency tail targets). That should sit in the scenarios tab.
- Resource ask: product needs one additional PM for two quarters to own cross-functional runbooks for Upside scenarios. I'll include a short JD in the sheet so Finance can estimate cost.

I'll join the 05/25 sync but suggest we add 10 minutes at the end for "risk signoffs" (security, compliance, procurement).

Thanks — Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Product Management
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Planning Playbook: targets, scenario bands & QBR readiness

Thanks everyone — clear asks. A couple of exec-level clarifications: 

- Finance treat Dedicated burst as opex for FY27 modelling (we want to avoid capex commitments where possible).
- For the June QBR we need a one-pager that includes: target bands, top 3 scenario triggers, and delta to FY27 plan in dollars. Please use the SLOs_and_Scenarios.md as the format reference (attached).
- If teams anticipate >15% downside to revenue in Conservative, schedule a separate exec review prior to the QBR.

I'll pull the draft one-pager together after your submissions and circulate a dry-run agenda for 06/03.

Laura Bennett
VP, Finance & Strategy
Redwood Inference

Attachment: SLOs_and_Scenarios.md

Subject: Re: Planning Playbook: targets, scenario bands & QBR readiness — consolidated action items

Following up with a consolidation after the inputs we received. Summary action items: 

1) All owners: enter target band + 2-sentence rationale in Planning_Playbook_Template.xlsx by EOD 05/27. (owner = column B in sheet)
2) Marissa: include probability column + ACME timing assumptions by 05/27.
3) Vivek & Eng: add capacity delta table and $/token notes by 05/22 (if you miss 05/22 call it out now so we can prorate).
4) Lauren: JD for temporary PM and canary scenario draft by 05/25.
5) Laura/Finance: roll-up model to be shared 05/27; Laura will produce the one-pager draft for dry-run.

Meeting: 05/25 10:00 AM PT cross-functional sync (calendar invite sent). Dry-run: 06/03 09:00 AM PT.

Link to live artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3C_planning-playbook
HubSpot ref: HS-00098123

Thanks all — flag any blockers here.

Ben
